futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2021 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2021 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy.

entries.quote: By the End of 2021, Based on Lessons Learned, 80% of Enterprises Will Put a Mechanism in Place to Shift to Cloud-Centric Infrastructure and Applications Twice as Fast as Before the Pandemic
entries.subject: Cloud-centric shift after the pandemic
entries.metric: share of enterprises with a mechanism to shift to cloud-centric infrastructure twice as fast

entries.quote: Through 2023, Reactions to Changed Workforce and Operations Practices During the Pandemic Will Be the Dominant Accelerators for 80% of Edge-Driven Investments and Business Model Changes in Most Industries
entries.subject: Edge investments
entries.metric: share of edge-driven investments accelerated by pandemic workforce and operations changes

entries.quote: By 2023, 75% of G2000 Companies Will Commit to Providing Technical Parity to a Workforce That Is Hybrid by Design Rather than by Circumstance, Enabling Them to Work Together Separately and in Real Time
entries.subject: Hybrid workforce technical parity
entries.metric: share of G2000 companies committing to technical parity for a hybrid workforce

entries.quote: Through 2023, Coping with Technical Debt Accumulated During the Pandemic Will Shadow 70% of CIOs, Causing Financial Stress, Inertial Drag on IT Agility, and "Forced March" Migrations to the Cloud
entries.subject: Pandemic technical debt
entries.metric: share of CIOs shadowed by pandemic technical debt

entries.quote: In 2022, Enterprises Focused on Digital Resiliency Will Adapt to Disruption and Extend Services to Respond to New Conditions 50% Faster than Ones Fixated on Restoring Existing Business/IT Resiliency Levels
entries.subject: Digital resiliency
entries.metric: speed advantage of digital-resiliency-focused enterprises in adapting to disruption

entries.quote: By 2023, an Emerging Cloud Ecosystem for Extending Resource Control and Real-Time Analytics Will Be the Underlying Platform for All IT and Business Automation Initiatives Anywhere and Everywhere
entries.subject: Cloud ecosystem for automation

entries.quote: By 2023, Driven by the Goal to Embed Intelligence in Products and Services, One-Quarter of G2000 Companies Will Acquire at Least One AI Software Start-Up to Ensure Ownership of Differentiated Skills and IP
entries.subject: AI start-up acquisitions
entries.metric: share of G2000 companies acquiring at least one AI software start-up

entries.quote: By 2024, 80% of Enterprises Will Overhaul Relationships with Suppliers, Providers, and Partners to Better Execute Digital Strategies for Ubiquitous Deployment of Resources and for Autonomous IT Operations
entries.subject: Supplier and partner relationships
entries.metric: share of enterprises overhauling supplier, provider and partner relationships

entries.quote: By 2025, 90% of G2000 Companies Will Mandate Reusable Materials in IT Hardware Supply Chains, Carbon Neutrality Targets for Providers' Facilities, and Lower Energy Use as Prerequisites for Doing Business
entries.subject: Sustainable IT supply chains
entries.metric: share of G2000 companies mandating reusable materials, carbon neutrality and lower energy use from IT providers

entries.quote: Through 2023, Half of Enterprises' Hybrid Workforce and Business Automation Efforts Will Be Delayed or Will Fail Outright Due to Underinvestment in Building IT/Sec/DevOps Teams with the Right Tools/Skills
entries.subject: Hybrid workforce and automation failures
entries.metric: share of enterprises' hybrid workforce and business automation efforts delayed or failed

entries.quote: By 2022, 65% of CIOs Will Digitally Empower and Enable Frontline Workers with Data, AI, and Security to Extend Their Productivity, Adaptability, and Decision Making in the Face of Rapid Changes
entries.subject: Frontline worker empowerment
entries.metric: share of CIOs empowering frontline workers with data, AI and security

entries.quote: By 2021, Unable to Find Adaptive Ways to Counter Escalating Cyberattacks, Unrest, Trade Wars, and Sudden Collapses, 30% of CIOs Will Fail in Protecting Trust — the Foundation of Customer Confidence
entries.subject: Trust protection failures
entries.metric: share of CIOs failing to protect trust

entries.quote: Through 2023, Coping with Technical Debt Accumulated During the Pandemic Will Shadow 70% of CIOs, Causing Financial Stress, Inertial Drag on IT Agility, and "Forced March" Migrations to the Cloud
entries.subject: Pandemic technical debt
entries.metric: share of CIOs shadowed by pandemic technical debt

entries.quote: By 2023, Global Crises Will Make 75% of CIOs Integral to Business Decision Making as Digital Infrastructure Becomes the Business OS While Moving from Business Continuation to Reconceptualization
entries.subject: CIOs in business decision making
entries.metric: share of CIOs integral to business decision making

entries.quote: By 2024, to Support Safe, Distributed Work Environments, 50% of CIOs Will Accelerate Robotization, Automation, and Augmentation, Making Change Management a Formidable Imperative
entries.subject: Robotization and automation
entries.metric: share of CIOs accelerating robotization, automation and augmentation

entries.quote: By 2023, CIO-Led Adversity Centers Will Become a Permanent Fixture in 65% of Enterprises, Focused on Building Resilience with Digital Infrastructure and Flexible Funding for Diverse Scenarios
entries.subject: CIO-led adversity centers
entries.metric: share of enterprises with CIO-led adversity centers

entries.quote: By 2025, 80% of CIOs Alongside LOBs Will Implement Intelligent Capabilities to Sense, Learn, and Predict Changing Customer Behaviors, Enabling Exclusive Customer Experiences for Engagement and Loyalty
entries.subject: Customer behavior intelligence
entries.metric: share of CIOs implementing intelligent capabilities to sense customer behavior

entries.quote: By 2025, 60% of CIOs Will Implement Governance for Low-Code/No-Code Tools to Increase IT and Business Productivity, Help LOB Developers Meet Unpredictable Needs, and Foster Innovation at the Edge
entries.subject: Low-code/no-code governance
entries.metric: share of CIOs implementing governance for low-code/no-code tools

entries.quote: By 2025, 65% of CIOs Will Implement Ecosystem, Application, and Infrastructure Control Systems Founded on Interoperability, Flexibility, Scalability, Portability, and Timeliness
entries.subject: Control systems for ecosystems
entries.metric: share of CIOs implementing ecosystem, application and infrastructure control systems

entries.quote: By 2024, 75% of CIOs Will Absorb New Accountabilities for the Management of Operational Health, Welfare, and Employee Location Data for Underwriting, Health, Safety, and Tax Compliance Purposes
entries.subject: Employee health and location data
entries.metric: share of CIOs absorbing accountability for employee health, welfare and location data

notes: IT Industry prediction 4 and CIO Agenda prediction 3 share the same sentence (pandemic technical debt, 70% of CIOs, through 2023).
